cover: Aviation chaos grips the United States while diplomatic chess plays out across continents
cover_scene: Commercial airliners grounded in silhouette under an ominous sky beside grand international negotiation halls adorned with national flags.

slides.scene: Dozens of passenger airliners lined up motionless on an asphalt tarmac under a gray overcast sky, with silhouettes of travelers waiting in the terminal.
slides.headline: FAA Grounds Flights Nationwide Over System Failure
slides.body: The US Federal Aviation Administration ordered a rare nationwide ground stop halting departing flights after legacy communications systems failed. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blamed 1980s network infrastructure, with thousands of flights canceled and recovery expected to take days.

slides.scene: A stern diplomatic meeting room flanked by Ukrainian and American flags, with maps of Eastern Europe laid out on a dark conference table.
slides.headline: US Floats Ukraine Donbas Concession Plan
slides.body: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy disclosed that US envoys proposed Ukrainian forces withdraw from the eastern Donbas region as a condition for joining NATO. The initiative follows diplomatic talks involving Donald Trump's representatives aimed at brokering an end to the war.

slides.scene: Three grand diplomatic chairs set before the national flags of the United States, China, and Russia in an ornate modern convention hall.
slides.headline: Trilateral Superpower Summit Scheduled for China
slides.body: Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin are planning an unprecedented trilateral summit scheduled to convene in China. White House officials indicated discussions will address nuclear weapons reductions alongside wider bilateral disputes, marking a rare simultaneous gathering of the three leaders.

slides.scene: Dignitaries in formal attire exchanging signed documents inside an opulent palace flanked by Turkish and Qatari flags and an honor guard.
slides.headline: Turkey and Qatar Sign Mutual Defense Pact
slides.body: Turkey and Qatar signed a mutual defense agreement establishing a joint security framework. The pact formally commits both nations to mount a coordinated response to military threats or external attacks directed against either country.

slides.scene: Military officers in green berets gathered in an official hall in Kampala, with tension evident among rows of uniformed personnel.
slides.headline: Ugandan Army Chief Arrests Top Generals
slides.body: General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, Uganda's army chief and son of President Yoweri Museveni, detained at least a dozen senior military officers. The sweeping purges follow his announcement to seek the presidency, shaking military leadership ahead of upcoming national elections.
